name: Dicom visualization
description: Provides a field widget and two file-field formatters that render DICOM (.dcm) medical imaging files in an interactive Cornerstone.js viewer.
project_description: DICOM Visualization renders medical imaging files (DICOM, .dcm extension) directly inside Drupal content by attaching field formatters to the core File field — no custom entity or media type is required. The client-side viewer is built on the Cornerstone.js stack (cornerstone-core, cornerstone-tools, cornerstone-wado-image-loader, dicom-parser and hammerjs, loaded from a CDN) and supports mouse-wheel zoom, window leveling (brightness/contrast) and panning. A standard 'DICOM File Formatter (Legacy)' overlays admin-selected DICOM metadata tags (Patient ID, Modality, Study Date and 45+ others) in the four viewport quadrants, configured globally at /admin/dicom-configuration. An 'Dicom Advanced File Formatter' adds 15+ colour themes and a per-display choice between individual viewers and a combined stack/gallery for multi-value fields. A companion 'Dicom File Widget' extends the core file widget on the edit form. The module requires only the core File module.
